typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DestDBNAME as string (),
	DestSCHEMANAME as string (),
	DestTABLENAME as string (),
	StrCallDestTable as string (),
	StrDestSCHEMANAME as string (),
	StrDestTABLENAME as string ()
}

source(output(
		LAST_DCL_DT as timestamp,
		TABLENAME as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DQL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DML_DT as timestamp,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB as integer,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_DDL_DT as timestamp,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		ROW_CT as integer,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as timestamp,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'with sb as (   select o.*, dense_rank () over (order by RPT_DT desc) rn   from AWB_SCHEMA."OBJECT_FEED" o ) select ENVRN_TXT   , DATABASENAME   , TABLENAME   , CREATOR_NAME   , CREATOR_EMP_ID   , CREATOR_FULL_NAME   , CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR   , CREATE_DT   , LAST_ALTER_DT   , LAST_DCL_DT   , LAST_DDL_DT   , LAST_DML_DT   , LAST_DQL_DT   , LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT   , CURRENT_PERM_MB   , ROW_CT   , RPT_DT from sb where rn <= 3',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		LAST_DCL_DT as string,
		TABLENAME as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		LAST_DQL_DT as string,
		LAST_DML_DT as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_DDL_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as string,
		ROW_CT as string,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as string,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		LAST_DCL_DT,
		TABLENAME,
		RPT_DT,
		LAST_DQL_DT,
		LAST_DML_DT,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB,
		ENVRN_TXT,
		CREATE_DT,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_DDL_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		LAST_ALTER_DT,
		ROW_CT,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME)) ~> OLEDBDestination
